title: Two-Product Manufacturing Production Mix LP
description: Classic two-variable linear program in standard MPS format maximizing manufacturing margin subject to machining and assembly hour capacities.
code:
* Two-Product Manufacturing Mix LP (Maximize 40 X1 + 30 X2)
NAME          PRODMIX
OBJSENSE
  MAX
ROWS
 N  PROFIT
 L  MACHINE
 L  ASSEMBLY
COLUMNS
    X1        PROFIT    40.0         MACHINE   2.0
    X1        ASSEMBLY  1.0
    X2        PROFIT    30.0         MACHINE   1.0
    X2        ASSEMBLY  1.0
RHS
    RHS1      MACHINE   100.0        ASSEMBLY  80.0
BOUNDS
 UP BND1      X1        45.0
 UP BND1      X2        70.0
ENDATA

title: Four-Alloy Furnace Blending Problem with Bounds
description: Minimum-cost metallurgical alloy blending LP mixing four scrap grades to meet exact 100-ton batch mass, minimum chromium, and maximum carbon limits.
code:
* Four-Alloy Furnace Blending Minimum-Cost LP
NAME          ALLOYBLD
OBJSENSE
  MIN
ROWS
 N  COST
 E  BATCH
 G  CHROMIUM
 L  CARBON
COLUMNS
    SCRAP1    COST      120.0        BATCH     1.0
    SCRAP1    CHROMIUM  0.18         CARBON    0.04
    SCRAP2    COST      155.0        BATCH     1.0
    SCRAP2    CHROMIUM  0.24         CARBON    0.02
    SCRAP3    COST      95.0         BATCH     1.0
    SCRAP3    CHROMIUM  0.10         CARBON    0.05
    PURECR    COST      380.0        BATCH     1.0
    PURECR    CHROMIUM  0.90         CARBON    0.005

    RHS1      BATCH     100.0        CHROMIUM  20.0
    RHS1      CARBON    3.0

 UP BND1      PURECR    25.0
ENDATA

title: Minimum-Cost Network Flow Routing LP
description: Four-node directed logistics network with node flow conservation equalities and arc capacity upper bounds minimizing total routing cost.
code:
* Minimum-Cost Network Flow (Source S -> Hubs A,B -> Sink T)
NAME          NETFLOW
OBJSENSE
  MIN
ROWS
 N  TOTCOST
 E  NODE_S
 E  NODE_A
 E  NODE_B
 E  NODE_T
COLUMNS
    ARC_SA    TOTCOST   4.0          NODE_S    1.0
    ARC_SA    NODE_A    -1.0
    ARC_SB    TOTCOST   6.0          NODE_S    1.0
    ARC_SB    NODE_B    -1.0
    ARC_AB    TOTCOST   2.0          NODE_A    1.0
    ARC_AB    NODE_B    -1.0

    ARC_AT    NODE_T    -1.0
    ARC_BT    TOTCOST   3.0          NODE_B    1.0

NAME          KNAPSACK
OBJSENSE
  MAX
ROWS

title: Warehouse Facility-Location Mixed-Integer Program

  MIN
